'all'), z.coerce .number() .int() .min(0) .max(100000) .parse(query.get('offset') ?? 0), queueFilters.parse({ owner: query.get('owner') || undefined, stage: query.get('stage') || undefined, route: query.get('route') || undefined, job: query.get('job') || undefined, }), ); }
workspace: async () => ({ ...(await s.evidence.workspace(ctx)), uploadsConfigured: s.uploadsConfigured, scanMode: s.scanMode, })

dispatch: async () => { const started: string[] = []; for (const job of await s.communications.pending(ctx)) { const runId = await communicationOrchestrator.start(job.id); await s.communications.started(ctx, job.id, runId); started.push(job.id); } return { started }; }
'mission-reply': () => { const v = z .object({ id: z.uuid(), replyId: z.uuid(), body: z.string().trim().min(3).max(2000) }) .parse(input); return s.missions.reply(ctx, v.id, v.body, v.replyId); }

verify: () => { if (!enabled('evidence.verification')) throw new DomainError('Verification is not enabled', 409); const v = z .object({ id: z.uuid(), decision: z.enum(['VERIFIED', 'REJECTED']), method: z.string(), scope: z.string(), validUntil: z.iso.datetime({ offset: true }), }) .parse(input); return s.evidence.verify(ctx, v.id, v); }

withTenant(this.pool, ctx, 'audit.read', async (t) => { const members = ( await t.db.query( 'SELECT user_id,role,revoked_at,allowed_purposes,allowed_classifications,allowed_countries FROM app.membership WHERE tenant_id=$1 ORDER BY created_at', [t.tenantId], ) ).rows; if (!this.identityPool || members.length === 0) return members; // Resolve names only after current tenant authorization, and only for its members. const profiles = await this.identityPool.query( 'SELECT p.id,u.name FROM identity.principal p JOIN identity."user" u ON u.id=p.identity_id WHERE p.id=ANY($1::uuid[])', [members.map((member) => member.user_id)], ); const names = new Map(profiles.rows.map((profile) => [profile.id, profile.name])); return members.map((member) => ({ ...member, name: names.get(member.user_id) ?? null })); })

withTenant(this.pool, ctx, 'members.manage', async (t) => { await t.db.query('SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended($1,0))', [t.tenantId]); const old = await t.db.query( 'SELECT role FROM app.membership WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND user_id=$2', [t.tenantId, v.userId], ); if (!old.rowCount) throw new DomainError('Membership unavailable', 404); if (old.rows[0].role === 'owner' && (v.role !== 'owner' || v.revoked)) { const count = await t.db.query( "SELECT count(*)::int AS count FROM app.membership WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND role='owner' AND revoked_at IS NULL", [t.tenantId], ); if (count.rows[0].count <= 1) throw new DomainError('The tenant must retain an active owner', 409); } await t.db.query( 'UPDATE app.membership SET role=$3,revoked_at=CASE WHEN $4 THEN now() ELSE NULL END WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND user_id=$2', [t.tenantId, v.userId, v.role, v.revoked], ); return { updated: true }; })

withTenant(this.pool, ctx, 'config.manage', async (t) => { await t.db.query('SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended($1,0))', [ `${t.tenantId}:${v.key}`, ]); const r = await t.db.query( `INSERT INTO app.config_version(tenant_id,key,version,value,effective_from,purpose,created_by) SELECT $1,$2,COALESCE(max(version),0)+1,$3::jsonb,now(),$4,$5 FROM app.config_version WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND key=$2 RETURNING id,version`, [t.tenantId, v.key, JSON.stringify({ enabled: v.enabled }), t.purpose, t.actorId], ); return r.rows[0]; })

withTenant(this.pool, ctx, 'communications.read', async ({ db, role }) => { const policies = ( await db.query( 'SELECT DISTINCT ON(jurisdiction,channel,contact_purpose) * FROM app.communication_policy WHERE tenant_id=$1 ORDER BY jurisdiction,channel,contact_purpose,version DESC', [ctx.tenantId], ) ).rows; const templates = ( await db.query( 'SELECT DISTINCT ON(name) * FROM app.communication_template WHERE tenant_id=$1 ORDER BY name,version DESC', [ctx.tenantId], ) ).rows; const targets = ( await db.query( `SELECT t.id,t.mission_id,t.relationship_id,o.name,m.status AS mission_status,i.brief->>'company' AS supplier FROM app.target_account t JOIN app.relationship r ON r.tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND r.id=t.relationship_id JOIN app.organisation o ON o.id=r.organisation_id JOIN app.mission m ON m.tenant_id=t.tenant_id AND m.id=t.mission_id JOIN app.mission_intake i ON i.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND i.id=m.id WHERE t.tenant_id=$1 AND m.status IN ('TARGETING','OUTREACH','MEETINGS') ORDER BY t.created_at DESC LIMIT 100`, [ctx.tenantId], ) ).rows; const contacts = ( await db.query( 'SELECT id,relationship_id,name,email,valid_until FROM app.private_contact_data WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND valid_until>now() ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100', [ctx.tenantId], ) ).rows; const messages = ( await db.query( `SELECT c.*,p.channel,l.id AS link_id,br.status AS decision,br.id AS response_id,br.created_at AS response_at,j.status AS delivery_status,j.attempts,j.last_error,j.workflow_run_id, EXISTS(SELECT FROM app.buyer_link_revocation r WHERE r.tenant_id=l.tenant_id AND r.link_id=l.id) AS revoked FROM app.communication c JOIN app.communication_policy p ON p.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND p.id=c.policy_id LEFT JOIN app.buyer_link l ON l.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND l.message_id=c.id LEFT JOIN app.buyer_response br ON br.tenant_id=l.tenant_id AND br.link_id=l.id LEFT JOIN app.communication_dispatch j ON j.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND j.id=c.id WHERE c.tenant_id=$1 ORDER BY c.created_at DESC LIMIT 50`, [ctx.tenantId], ) ).rows; const optouts = ( await db.query( 'SELECT id,contact_id,reason,created_at FROM app.communication_optout WHERE tenant_id=$1 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50', [ctx.tenantId], ) ).rows; const attempts = ( await db.query( 'SELECT * FROM app.communication_attempt WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND message_id=ANY($2::uuid[]) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100', [ctx.tenantId, messages.map((m) => m.id)], ) ).rows; return { role, policies, templates, targets, contacts, messages, optouts, attempts }; })

withTenant( this.pool, ctx, ['policy', 'template'].includes(v.action) ? 'communications.approve' : 'communications.manage', async ({ db, actorId }) => { await db.query('SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended($1,0))', [ `${ctx.tenantId}:communications`, ]); const old = ( await db.query('SELECT * FROM app.communication_command WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND id=$2', [ ctx.tenantId, v.commandId, ]) ).rows[0]; if (old) { if (old.input_hash !== digest || old.created_by !== actorId) throw new DomainError('Command key reused with different values', 409); return old.result as { id: string }; } let id = v.commandId; if (v.action === 'policy') { const r = await db.query( `INSERT INTO app.communication_policy(tenant_id,jurisdiction,channel,contact_purpose,version,basis,enabled,valid_until,created_by) SELECT $1,$2,$3,$4,coalesce(max(version),0)+1,$5,$6,$7,$8 FROM app.communication_policy WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND jurisdiction=$2 AND channel=$3 AND contact_purpose=$4 RETURNING id`, [ ctx.tenantId, v.jurisdiction, v.channel, v.contactPurpose, v.basis, v.enabled, v.validUntil, actorId, ], ); id = r.rows[0].id; } else if (v.action === 'template') { const r = await db.query( `INSERT INTO app.communication_template(tenant_id,name,version,contact_purpose,body,created_by) SELECT $1,$2,coalesce(max(version),0)+1,$3,$4,$5 FROM app.communication_template WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND name=$2 RETURNING id`, [ctx.tenantId, v.name, v.contactPurpose, v.body, actorId], ); id = r.rows[0].id; } else if (v.action === 'introduce') { const enabled = ( await db.query( "SELECT app.communication_enabled($1,'communications.introductions') AS enabled", [ctx.tenantId], ) ).rows[0].enabled; if (!enabled) throw new DomainError('New introductions are disabled', 409); await db.query( 'INSERT INTO app.communication(id,tenant_id,target_id,contact_id,policy_id,template_id,presentation,expires_at,created_by) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7::jsonb,$8,$9)', [ id, ctx.tenantId, v.targetId, v.contactId, v.policyId, v.templateId, JSON.stringify(v.introduction), v.expiresAt, actorId, ], ); await db.query( 'INSERT INTO app.buyer_link(id,tenant_id,message_id,token_hash,created_by) VALUES($1,$2,$1,$3,$4)', [id, ctx.tenantId, hash(this.capability('buyer', id)), actorId], ); await db.query('SELECT app.queue_communication($1,$2)', [ id, hash(this.dispatchCapability(id)), ]); } else if (v.action === 'revoke') { const l = ( await db.query('SELECT * FROM app.buyer_link WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND id=$2', [ ctx.tenantId, v.linkId, ]) ).rows[0]; if (!l) throw new DomainError('Introduction unavailable', 404);
